## Join us

We are always interested in collaborating with trialists, methodologists, and
clinicians working on critical care. If our methods are relevant to a trial you
are running or re-analysing, please get in touch with
[Michael Harhay](mailto:mharhay@pennmedicine.upenn.edu) or
[Fan Li](mailto:fan.f.li@yale.edu).
